newsitem.title: USA: Maxxon says Short resigns as president.
newsitem.headline: Maxxon says Short resigns as president.

text.p: Maxxon Inc said Thursday it appointed Gifford Mabie as president of the company following the resignation of Bruce Short.
In addition, the company said the board has approved a strategic alliance with Texas Applied Biotechnology Services for the development and testing of the Maxxon Safety Syringe.
The deal with follows the termination by the company of a similar arrangement with Leigh Med Tech, the company said.
Maxxon said Short resigned to pursue other interests.
